    "# Categorical: Fill missing with 'missing' label and One-Hot Encode\n",
    "categorical_transformer = Pipeline(steps=[\n",
    "    ('imputer', SimpleImputer(strategy='constant', fill_value='missing')),\n",
    "    ('onehot', OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore'))\n",
    "])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 83,
   "id": "7685c094",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(\n",
    "    transformers=[\n",
    "        ('num', numeric_transformer, numeric_features),\n",
    "        ('cat', categorical_transformer, categorical_features)\n",
    "    ])"
   ]
  },

    "# 5. Define the Model Pipeline\n",

       "    </div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><script>function copyToClipboard(text, element) {\n",
       "    // Get the parameter prefix from the closest toggleable content\n",
       "    const toggleableContent = element.closest('.sk-toggleable__content');\n",
       "    const paramPrefix = toggleableContent ? toggleableContent.dataset.paramPrefix : '';\n",
       "    const fullParamName = paramPrefix ? `${paramPrefix}${text}` : text;\n",
       "\n",
       "    const originalStyle = element.style;\n",
       "    const computedStyle = window.getComputedStyle(element);\n",
       "    const originalWidth = computedStyle.width;\n",
       "    const originalHTML = element.innerHTML.replace('Copied!', '');\n",
       "\n",
       "    navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullParamName)\n",
       "        .then(() => {\n",
       "            element.style.width = originalWidth;\n",
       "            element.style.color = 'green';\n",
       "            element.innerHTML = \"Copied!\";\n",
       "\n",
       "            setTimeout(() => {\n",
       "                element.innerHTML = originalHTML;\n",
       "                element.style = originalStyle;\n",
       "            }, 2000);\n",
       "        })\n",
       "        .catch(err => {\n",
       "            console.error('Failed to copy:', err);\n",
       "            element.style.color = 'red';\n",
       "            element.innerHTML = \"Failed!\";\n",
       "            setTimeout(() => {\n",
       "                element.innerHTML = originalHTML;\n",
       "                element.style = originalStyle;\n",
       "            }, 2000);\n",
       "        });\n",
       "    return false;\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "document.querySelectorAll('.copy-paste-icon').forEach(function(element) {\n",
       "    const toggleableContent = element.closest('.sk-toggleable__content');\n",
       "    const paramPrefix = toggleableContent ? toggleableContent.dataset.paramPrefix : '';\n",
       "    const paramName = element.parentElement.nextElementSibling\n",
       "        .textContent.trim().split(' ')[0];\n",
       "    const fullParamName = paramPrefix ? `${paramPrefix}${paramName}` : paramName;\n",
       "\n",
       "    element.setAttribute('title', fullParamName);\n",
       "});\n",
       "\n",
       "\n",
       "/**\n",
       " * Adapted from Skrub\n",
       " * https://github.com/skrub-data/skrub/blob/403466d1d5d4dc76a7ef569b3f8228db59a31dc3/skrub/_reporting/_data/templates/report.js#L789\n",
       " * @returns \"light\" or \"dark\"\n",
       " */\n",
       "function detectTheme(element) {\n",
       "    const body = document.querySelector('body');\n",
       "\n",
       "    // Check VSCode theme\n",
       "    const themeKindAttr = body.getAttribute('data-vscode-theme-kind');\n",
       "    const themeNameAttr = body.getAttribute('data-vscode-theme-name');\n",
       "\n",
       "    if (themeKindAttr && themeNameAttr) {\n",
       "        const themeKind = themeKindAttr.toLowerCase();\n",
       "        const themeName = themeNameAttr.toLowerCase();\n",
       "\n",
       "        if (themeKind.includes(\"dark\") || themeName.includes(\"dark\")) {\n",
       "            return \"dark\";\n",
       "        }\n",
       "        if (themeKind.includes(\"light\") || themeName.includes(\"light\")) {\n",
       "            return \"light\";\n",
       "        }\n",
       "    }\n",
       "\n",
       "    // Check Jupyter theme\n",
       "    if (body.getAttribute('data-jp-theme-light') === 'false') {\n",
       "        return 'dark';\n",
       "    } else if (body.getAttribute('data-jp-theme-light') === 'true') {\n",
       "        return 'light';\n",
       "    }\n",
       "\n",
       "    // Guess based on a parent element's color\n",
       "    const color = window.getComputedStyle(element.parentNode, null).getPropertyValue('color');\n",
       "    const match = color.match(/^rgb\\s*\\(\\s*(\\d+)\\s*,\\s*(\\d+)\\s*,\\s*(\\d+)\\s*\\)\\s*$/i);\n",
       "    if (match) {\n",
       "        const [r, g, b] = [\n",
       "            parseFloat(match[1]),\n",
       "            parseFloat(match[2]),\n",
       "            parseFloat(match[3])\n",
       "        ];\n",
       "\n",
       "        // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HSL_and_HSV#Lightness\n",
       "        const luma = 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b;\n",
       "\n",
       "        if (luma > 180) {\n",
       "            // If the text is very bright we have a dark theme\n",
       "            return 'dark';\n",
       "        }\n",
       "        if (luma < 75) {\n",
       "            // If the text is very dark we have a light theme\n",
       "            return 'light';\n",
       "        }\n",
       "        // Otherwise fall back to the next heuristic.\n",
       "    }\n",
       "\n",
       "    // Fallback to system preference\n",
       "    return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "\n",
       "function forceTheme(elementId) {\n",
       "    const estimatorElement = document.querySelector(`#${elementId}`);\n",
       "    if (estimatorElement === null) {\n",
       "        console.error(`Element with id ${elementId} not found.`);\n",
       "    } else {\n",
       "        const theme = detectTheme(estimatorElement);\n",
       "        estimatorElement.classList.add(theme);\n",
       "    }\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "forceTheme('sk-container-id-3');</script></body>"
      ],
      "text/plain": [
       "RandomizedSearchCV(cv=3,\n",
       "                   estimator=Pipeline(steps=[('preprocessor',\n",
       "                                              ColumnTransformer(transformers=[('num',\n",
       "                                                                               SimpleImputer(strategy='median'),\n",
       "                                                                               Index(['experience_years', 'salary_usd', 'bonus_usd', 'interview_rounds',\n",
       "       'year', 'weekly_hours', 'company_rating', 'job_openings',\n",
       "       'hiring_difficulty_score', 'ai_adoption_score',\n",
       "       'company_funding_billion', 'economic_index'...\n",
       "                                                                               Index(['country', 'job_role', 'ai_specialization', 'experience_level',\n",
       "       'education_required', 'industry', 'company_size', 'work_mode'],\n",
       "      dtype='str'))])),\n",
       "                                             ('regressor',\n",
       "                                              RandomForestRegressor(random_state=42))]),\n",
       "                   n_iter=5, n_jobs=-1,\n",
       "                   param_distributions={'regressor__max_depth': [10, 20, None],\n",
       "                                        'regressor__min_samples_split': [2, 5],\n",
       "                                        'regressor__n_estimators': [100, 200]},\n",
       "                   random_state=42)"
      ]

       "    </div></div></div></div></div><script>function copyToClipboard(text, element) {\n",
       "    // Get the parameter prefix from the closest toggleable content\n",
       "    const toggleableContent = element.closest('.sk-toggleable__content');\n",
       "    const paramPrefix = toggleableContent ? toggleableContent.dataset.paramPrefix : '';\n",
       "    const fullParamName = paramPrefix ? `${paramPrefix}${text}` : text;\n",
       "\n",
       "    const originalStyle = element.style;\n",
       "    const computedStyle = window.getComputedStyle(element);\n",
       "    const originalWidth = computedStyle.width;\n",
       "    const originalHTML = element.innerHTML.replace('Copied!', '');\n",
       "\n",
       "    navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullParamName)\n",
       "        .then(() => {\n",
       "            element.style.width = originalWidth;\n",
       "            element.style.color = 'green';\n",
       "            element.innerHTML = \"Copied!\";\n",
       "\n",
       "            setTimeout(() => {\n",
       "                element.innerHTML = originalHTML;\n",
       "                element.style = originalStyle;\n",
       "            }, 2000);\n",
       "        })\n",
       "        .catch(err => {\n",
       "            console.error('Failed to copy:', err);\n",
       "            element.style.color = 'red';\n",
       "            element.innerHTML = \"Failed!\";\n",
       "            setTimeout(() => {\n",
       "                element.innerHTML = originalHTML;\n",
       "                element.style = originalStyle;\n",
       "            }, 2000);\n",
       "        });\n",
       "    return false;\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "document.querySelectorAll('.copy-paste-icon').forEach(function(element) {\n",
       "    const toggleableContent = element.closest('.sk-toggleable__content');\n",
       "    const paramPrefix = toggleableContent ? toggleableContent.dataset.paramPrefix : '';\n",
       "    const paramName = element.parentElement.nextElementSibling\n",
       "        .textContent.trim().split(' ')[0];\n",
       "    const fullParamName = paramPrefix ? `${paramPrefix}${paramName}` : paramName;\n",
       "\n",
       "    element.setAttribute('title', fullParamName);\n",
       "});\n",
       "\n",
       "\n",
       "/**\n",
       " * Adapted from Skrub\n",
       " * https://github.com/skrub-data/skrub/blob/403466d1d5d4dc76a7ef569b3f8228db59a31dc3/skrub/_reporting/_data/templates/report.js#L789\n",
       " * @returns \"light\" or \"dark\"\n",
       " */\n",
       "function detectTheme(element) {\n",
       "    const body = document.querySelector('body');\n",
       "\n",
       "    // Check VSCode theme\n",
       "    const themeKindAttr = body.getAttribute('data-vscode-theme-kind');\n",
       "    const themeNameAttr = body.getAttribute('data-vscode-theme-name');\n",
       "\n",
       "    if (themeKindAttr && themeNameAttr) {\n",
       "        const themeKind = themeKindAttr.toLowerCase();\n",
       "        const themeName = themeNameAttr.toLowerCase();\n",
       "\n",
       "        if (themeKind.includes(\"dark\") || themeName.includes(\"dark\")) {\n",
       "            return \"dark\";\n",
       "        }\n",
       "        if (themeKind.includes(\"light\") || themeName.includes(\"light\")) {\n",
       "            return \"light\";\n",
       "        }\n",
       "    }\n",
       "\n",
       "    // Check Jupyter theme\n",
       "    if (body.getAttribute('data-jp-theme-light') === 'false') {\n",
       "        return 'dark';\n",
       "    } else if (body.getAttribute('data-jp-theme-light') === 'true') {\n",
       "        return 'light';\n",
       "    }\n",
       "\n",
       "    // Guess based on a parent element's color\n",
       "    const color = window.getComputedStyle(element.parentNode, null).getPropertyValue('color');\n",
       "    const match = color.match(/^rgb\\s*\\(\\s*(\\d+)\\s*,\\s*(\\d+)\\s*,\\s*(\\d+)\\s*\\)\\s*$/i);\n",
       "    if (match) {\n",
       "        const [r, g, b] = [\n",
       "            parseFloat(match[1]),\n",
       "            parseFloat(match[2]),\n",
       "            parseFloat(match[3])\n",
       "        ];\n",
       "\n",
       "        // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HSL_and_HSV#Lightness\n",
       "        const luma = 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b;\n",
       "\n",
       "        if (luma > 180) {\n",
       "            // If the text is very bright we have a dark theme\n",
       "            return 'dark';\n",
       "        }\n",
       "        if (luma < 75) {\n",
       "            // If the text is very dark we have a light theme\n",
       "            return 'light';\n",
       "        }\n",
       "        // Otherwise fall back to the next heuristic.\n",
       "    }\n",
       "\n",
       "    // Fallback to system preference\n",
       "    return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "\n",
       "function forceTheme(elementId) {\n",
       "    const estimatorElement = document.querySelector(`#${elementId}`);\n",
       "    if (estimatorElement === null) {\n",
       "        console.error(`Element with id ${elementId} not found.`);\n",
       "    } else {\n",
       "        const theme = detectTheme(estimatorElement);\n",
       "        estimatorElement.classList.add(theme);\n",
       "    }\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "forceTheme('sk-container-id-8');</script></body>"
      ],

    "# 2. Define our Input Features (What the user wants) and Target (The Country)\n",
    "pos_factors = ['salary_usd', 'vacation_days', 'job_security_score', 'work_life_balance_score', 'employee_satisfaction', 'career_growth_score']\n",
    "neg_factors = ['weekly_hours', 'layoff_risk', 'tax_rate_percent', 'cost_of_living_index']\n",
    "categorical_features = ['job_role', 'experience_level']"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 54,
   "id": "b37104e9",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "features = categorical_features + pos_factors + neg_factors\n",
    "X = df[features]\n",
    "y = df['country']"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 55,
   "id": "1d8989fb",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# 3. Preprocessing Engine\n",
    "# Neural Networks are very sensitive to scale. We MUST standardize the numbers (e.g., salary vs. risk).\n",
    "preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(\n",
    "    transformers=[\n",
    "        ('num', StandardScaler(), pos_factors + neg_factors),\n",
    "        ('cat', OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore'), categorical_features)\n",
    "    ])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 56,
   "id": "2298b23e",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# 4. Build the Neural Network Pipeline\n",
    "# We use two hidden layers (64 neurons, then 32 neurons) to learn the complex factor interactions.\n",
    "nn_pipeline = Pipeline([\n",
    "    ('preprocessor', preprocessor),\n",
    "    ('classifier', MLPClassifier(\n",
    "        hidden_layer_sizes=(64, 32), \n",
    "        activation='relu',       # Handles non-linear relationships\n",
    "        solver='adam',           # Excellent optimizer for this type of data\n",
    "        max_iter=100,            # Adjust higher if needed for convergence\n",
    "        random_state=42\n",
    "    ))\n",
    "])"
   ]

       "    </div></div></div></div></div></div></div><script>function copyToClipboard(text, element) {\n",
       "    // Get the parameter prefix from the closest toggleable content\n",
       "    const toggleableContent = element.closest('.sk-toggleable__content');\n",
       "    const paramPrefix = toggleableContent ? toggleableContent.dataset.paramPrefix : '';\n",
       "    const fullParamName = paramPrefix ? `${paramPrefix}${text}` : text;\n",
       "\n",
       "    const originalStyle = element.style;\n",
       "    const computedStyle = window.getComputedStyle(element);\n",
       "    const originalWidth = computedStyle.width;\n",
       "    const originalHTML = element.innerHTML.replace('Copied!', '');\n",
       "\n",
       "    navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullParamName)\n",
       "        .then(() => {\n",
       "            element.style.width = originalWidth;\n",
       "            element.style.color = 'green';\n",
       "            element.innerHTML = \"Copied!\";\n",
       "\n",
       "            setTimeout(() => {\n",
       "                element.innerHTML = originalHTML;\n",
       "                element.style = originalStyle;\n",
       "            }, 2000);\n",
       "        })\n",
       "        .catch(err => {\n",
       "            console.error('Failed to copy:', err);\n",
       "            element.style.color = 'red';\n",
       "            element.innerHTML = \"Failed!\";\n",
       "            setTimeout(() => {\n",
       "                element.innerHTML = originalHTML;\n",
       "                element.style = originalStyle;\n",
       "            }, 2000);\n",
       "        });\n",
       "    return false;\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "document.querySelectorAll('.copy-paste-icon').forEach(function(element) {\n",
       "    const toggleableContent = element.closest('.sk-toggleable__content');\n",
       "    const paramPrefix = toggleableContent ? toggleableContent.dataset.paramPrefix : '';\n",
       "    const paramName = element.parentElement.nextElementSibling\n",
       "        .textContent.trim().split(' ')[0];\n",
       "    const fullParamName = paramPrefix ? `${paramPrefix}${paramName}` : paramName;\n",
       "\n",
       "    element.setAttribute('title', fullParamName);\n",
       "});\n",
       "\n",
       "\n",
       "/**\n",
       " * Adapted from Skrub\n",
       " * https://github.com/skrub-data/skrub/blob/403466d1d5d4dc76a7ef569b3f8228db59a31dc3/skrub/_reporting/_data/templates/report.js#L789\n",
       " * @returns \"light\" or \"dark\"\n",
       " */\n",
       "function detectTheme(element) {\n",
       "    const body = document.querySelector('body');\n",
       "\n",
       "    // Check VSCode theme\n",
       "    const themeKindAttr = body.getAttribute('data-vscode-theme-kind');\n",
       "    const themeNameAttr = body.getAttribute('data-vscode-theme-name');\n",
       "\n",
       "    if (themeKindAttr && themeNameAttr) {\n",
       "        const themeKind = themeKindAttr.toLowerCase();\n",
       "        const themeName = themeNameAttr.toLowerCase();\n",
       "\n",
       "        if (themeKind.includes(\"dark\") || themeName.includes(\"dark\")) {\n",
       "            return \"dark\";\n",
       "        }\n",
       "        if (themeKind.includes(\"light\") || themeName.includes(\"light\")) {\n",
       "            return \"light\";\n",
       "        }\n",
       "    }\n",
       "\n",
       "    // Check Jupyter theme\n",
       "    if (body.getAttribute('data-jp-theme-light') === 'false') {\n",
       "        return 'dark';\n",
       "    } else if (body.getAttribute('data-jp-theme-light') === 'true') {\n",
       "        return 'light';\n",
       "    }\n",
       "\n",
       "    // Guess based on a parent element's color\n",
       "    const color = window.getComputedStyle(element.parentNode, null).getPropertyValue('color');\n",
       "    const match = color.match(/^rgb\\s*\\(\\s*(\\d+)\\s*,\\s*(\\d+)\\s*,\\s*(\\d+)\\s*\\)\\s*$/i);\n",
       "    if (match) {\n",
       "        const [r, g, b] = [\n",
       "            parseFloat(match[1]),\n",
       "            parseFloat(match[2]),\n",
       "            parseFloat(match[3])\n",
       "        ];\n",
       "\n",
       "        // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HSL_and_HSV#Lightness\n",
       "        const luma = 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b;\n",
       "\n",
       "        if (luma > 180) {\n",
       "            // If the text is very bright we have a dark theme\n",
       "            return 'dark';\n",
       "        }\n",
       "        if (luma < 75) {\n",
       "            // If the text is very dark we have a light theme\n",
       "            return 'light';\n",
       "        }\n",
       "        // Otherwise fall back to the next heuristic.\n",
       "    }\n",
       "\n",
       "    // Fallback to system preference\n",
       "    return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "\n",
       "function forceTheme(elementId) {\n",
       "    const estimatorElement = document.querySelector(`#${elementId}`);\n",
       "    if (estimatorElement === null) {\n",
       "        console.error(`Element with id ${elementId} not found.`);\n",
       "    } else {\n",
       "        const theme = detectTheme(estimatorElement);\n",
       "        estimatorElement.classList.add(theme);\n",
       "    }\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "forceTheme('sk-container-id-2');</script></body>"
      ],
      "text/plain": [
       "Pipeline(steps=[('preprocessor',\n",
       "                 ColumnTransformer(transformers=[('num', StandardScaler(),\n",
       "                                                  ['salary_usd',\n",
       "                                                   'vacation_days',\n",
       "                                                   'job_security_score',\n",
       "                                                   'work_life_balance_score',\n",
       "                                                   'employee_satisfaction',\n",
       "                                                   'career_growth_score',\n",

       "                                                   'layoff_risk',\n",

       "                                                 ('cat',\n",

       "                ('classifier',\n",
       "                 MLPClassifier(hidden_layer_sizes=(64, 32), max_iter=100,\n",

    "# =========================\n",
    "# 8. Recommendation function\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "def recommend_countries(candidate_profile, model_pipeline, label_encoder, top_n=3):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    candidate_profile should be a dictionary with the same feature names used in training.\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "    candidate_df = pd.DataFrame([candidate_profile])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Ensure all missing columns exist\n",
    "    for col in features:\n",
    "        if col not in candidate_df.columns:\n",
    "            candidate_df[col] = np.nan\n",
    "\n",
    "    candidate_df = candidate_df[features]\n",
    "\n",
    "    probs = model_pipeline.predict_proba(candidate_df)[0]\n",
    "    top_idx = probs.argsort()[-top_n:][::-1]\n",
    "\n",
    "    results = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    for idx in top_idx:\n",
    "        country = label_encoder.inverse_transform([idx])[0]\n",
    "        probability = probs[idx]\n",
    "        results.append((country, probability))\n",
    "\n",
    "    return results"
   ]

      "\n",
      "===== COMBINED MODEL RECOMMENDATIONS =====\n",
      "     country  combined_score      mlp_score  gb_score\n",
      "0     Brazil        0.271852   5.433729e-01  0.000331\n",
      "1      India        0.228433   4.566271e-01  0.000239\n",
      "2        USA        0.099819  1.009841e-277  0.199638\n",
      "3  Australia        0.080689  3.807099e-148  0.161378\n",
      "4         UK        0.059641  1.011817e-110  0.119283\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "def recommend_combined(candidate_profile, mlp_model, gb_model, label_encoder, top_n=5):\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Convert to dataframe\n",
    "    candidate_df = pd.DataFrame([candidate_profile])\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Ensure all columns exist\n",
    "    for col in features:\n",
    "        if col not in candidate_df.columns:\n",
    "            candidate_df[col] = np.nan\n",
    "    \n",
    "    candidate_df = candidate_df[features]\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Get probabilities\n",
    "    mlp_probs = mlp_model.predict_proba(candidate_df)[0]\n",
    "    gb_probs = gb_model.predict_proba(candidate_df)[0]\n",
    "    \n",
    "    mlp_probs = mlp_probs / mlp_probs.sum()\n",
    "    gb_probs = gb_probs / gb_probs.sum()\n",
    "\n",
    "    combined_probs = (mlp_probs + gb_probs) / 2\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Get indices of top countries\n",
    "    top_idx = combined_probs.argsort()[-top_n:][::-1]\n",
    "    \n",
    "    results = []\n",
    "    \n",
    "    for i in top_idx:\n",
    "        country = label_encoder.inverse_transform([i])[0]\n",
    "        \n",
    "        results.append({\n",
    "            'country': country,\n",
    "            'combined_score': combined_probs[i],\n",
    "            'mlp_score': mlp_probs[i],\n",
    "            'gb_score': gb_probs[i]\n",
    "        })\n",
    "    \n",
    "    return pd.DataFrame(results)\n",
    "\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "# Run on your sample profile\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "combined_results = recommend_combined(\n",
    "    candidate_profile,\n",
    "    mlp_pipeline,\n",
    "    gb_pipeline,\n",
    "    label_encoder,\n",
    "    top_n=5\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n===== COMBINED MODEL RECOMMENDATIONS =====\")\n",
    "print(combined_results)"
   ]
  },

    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder\n",
    "from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer\n",
    "from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity\n",
    "\n",
    "df = pd.read_csv(\"global_ai_jobs.csv\")\n",
    "\n",
    "features = [\n",
    "    'salary_usd',\n",
    "    'vacation_days',\n",
    "    'job_security_score',\n",
    "    'work_life_balance_score',\n",
    "    'employee_satisfaction',\n",
    "    'career_growth_score',\n",
    "    'weekly_hours',\n",
    "    'layoff_risk',\n",
    "    'tax_rate_percent',\n",
    "    'cost_of_living_index',\n",
    "    'job_role',\n",
    "    'experience_level',\n",
    "    'industry',\n",
    "    'education_required',\n",
    "    'ai_specialization'\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "features = [c for c in features if c in df.columns]\n",
    "\n",
    "# Split numeric and categorical safely\n",
    "num_cols = df[features].select_dtypes(include=np.number).columns.tolist()\n",
    "cat_cols = [c for c in features if c not in num_cols]\n",
    "\n",
    "# Numeric: mean per country\n",
    "country_num = df.groupby('country')[num_cols].mean()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Categorical: most common value per country\n",
    "def safe_mode(x):\n",
    "    mode = x.dropna().mode()\n",
    "    return mode.iloc[0] if len(mode) > 0 else np.nan\n",
    "\n",
    "country_cat = df.groupby('country')[cat_cols].agg(safe_mode)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Combine\n",
    "country_profiles = pd.concat([country_num, country_cat], axis=1).reset_index()\n",
    "\n",
    "X = country_profiles[features]\n",
    "\n",
    "preprocessor = ColumnTransformer([\n",
    "    ('num', StandardScaler(), num_cols),\n",
    "    ('cat', OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore'), cat_cols)\n",
    "])\n",
    "\n",
    "X_country = preprocessor.fit_transform(X)\n",
    "\n",
    "candidate_profile = {\n",
    "    'salary_usd': 120000,\n",
    "    'vacation_days': 18,\n",
    "    'job_security_score': 8.0,\n",
    "    'work_life_balance_score': 7.5,\n",
    "    'employee_satisfaction': 8.0,\n",
    "    'career_growth_score': 8.5,\n",
    "    'weekly_hours': 40,\n",
    "    'layoff_risk': 0.15,\n",
    "    'tax_rate_percent': 25,\n",
    "    'cost_of_living_index': 80,\n",
    "    'job_role': 'Data Scientist',\n",
    "    'experience_level': 'Mid-level',\n",
    "    'industry': 'Technology',\n",
    "    'education_required': 'Master',\n",
    "    'ai_specialization': 'Machine Learning'\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "candidate_df = pd.DataFrame([candidate_profile])\n",
    "\n",
    "# Ensure all columns exist\n",
    "for col in features:\n",
    "    if col not in candidate_df.columns:\n",
    "        candidate_df[col] = np.nan\n",
    "\n",
    "candidate_df = candidate_df[features]\n",
    "\n",
    "X_candidate = preprocessor.transform(candidate_df)\n",
    "\n",
    "scores = cosine_similarity(X_candidate, X_country)[0]\n",
    "\n",
    "recommendations = country_profiles[['country']].copy()\n",
    "recommendations['similarity_score'] = scores\n",
    "\n",
    "recommendations = recommendations.sort_values('similarity_score', ascending=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(recommendations.head(10))"
   ]

    "weights = {\n",
    "    'salary_usd': 2.0,\n",
    "    'job_security_score': 2.0,\n",
    "    'work_life_balance_score': 1.5,\n",
    "    'employee_satisfaction': 1.5,\n",
    "    'career_growth_score': 1.5,\n",
    "    'vacation_days': 1.0,\n",
    "    'weekly_hours': -1.0,\n",
    "    'layoff_risk': -2.0,\n",
    "    'tax_rate_percent': -1.0,\n",
    "    'cost_of_living_index': -1.5\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "country_scores = df.groupby('country').agg({\n",
    "    'salary_usd': 'mean',\n",
    "    'job_security_score': 'mean',\n",
    "    'work_life_balance_score': 'mean',\n",
    "    'employee_satisfaction': 'mean',\n",
    "    'career_growth_score': 'mean',\n",
    "    'vacation_days': 'mean',\n",
    "    'weekly_hours': 'mean',\n",
    "    'layoff_risk': 'mean',\n",
    "    'tax_rate_percent': 'mean',\n",
    "    'cost_of_living_index': 'mean'\n",
    "}).reset_index()\n",
    "\n",
    "# normalize\n",
    "for col in weights:\n",
    "    country_scores[col + '_norm'] = (\n",
    "        country_scores[col] - country_scores[col].min()\n",
    "    ) / (country_scores[col].max() - country_scores[col].min())\n",
    "\n",
    "country_scores['recommendation_score'] = 0\n",
    "\n",
    "for col, weight in weights.items():\n",
    "    country_scores['recommendation_score'] += (\n",
    "        weight * country_scores[col + '_norm']\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "country_scores = country_scores.sort_values(\n",
    "    'recommendation_score',\n",
    "    ascending=False\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(country_scores[['country', 'recommendation_score']].head(10))"

       "    </div></div></div></div></div><script>function copyToClipboard(text, element) {\n",
       "    // Get the parameter prefix from the closest toggleable content\n",
       "    const toggleableContent = element.closest('.sk-toggleable__content');\n",
       "    const paramPrefix = toggleableContent ? toggleableContent.dataset.paramPrefix : '';\n",
       "    const fullParamName = paramPrefix ? `${paramPrefix}${text}` : text;\n",
       "\n",
       "    const originalStyle = element.style;\n",
       "    const computedStyle = window.getComputedStyle(element);\n",
       "    const originalWidth = computedStyle.width;\n",
       "    const originalHTML = element.innerHTML.replace('Copied!', '');\n",
       "\n",
       "    navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullParamName)\n",
       "        .then(() => {\n",
       "            element.style.width = originalWidth;\n",
       "            element.style.color = 'green';\n",
       "            element.innerHTML = \"Copied!\";\n",
       "\n",
       "            setTimeout(() => {\n",
       "                element.innerHTML = originalHTML;\n",
       "                element.style = originalStyle;\n",
       "            }, 2000);\n",
       "        })\n",
       "        .catch(err => {\n",
       "            console.error('Failed to copy:', err);\n",
       "            element.style.color = 'red';\n",
       "            element.innerHTML = \"Failed!\";\n",
       "            setTimeout(() => {\n",
       "                element.innerHTML = originalHTML;\n",
       "                element.style = originalStyle;\n",
       "            }, 2000);\n",
       "        });\n",
       "    return false;\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "document.querySelectorAll('.copy-paste-icon').forEach(function(element) {\n",
       "    const toggleableContent = element.closest('.sk-toggleable__content');\n",
       "    const paramPrefix = toggleableContent ? toggleableContent.dataset.paramPrefix : '';\n",
       "    const paramName = element.parentElement.nextElementSibling\n",
       "        .textContent.trim().split(' ')[0];\n",
       "    const fullParamName = paramPrefix ? `${paramPrefix}${paramName}` : paramName;\n",
       "\n",
       "    element.setAttribute('title', fullParamName);\n",
       "});\n",
       "\n",
       "\n",
       "/**\n",
       " * Adapted from Skrub\n",
       " * https://github.com/skrub-data/skrub/blob/403466d1d5d4dc76a7ef569b3f8228db59a31dc3/skrub/_reporting/_data/templates/report.js#L789\n",
       " * @returns \"light\" or \"dark\"\n",
       " */\n",
       "function detectTheme(element) {\n",
       "    const body = document.querySelector('body');\n",
       "\n",
       "    // Check VSCode theme\n",
       "    const themeKindAttr = body.getAttribute('data-vscode-theme-kind');\n",
       "    const themeNameAttr = body.getAttribute('data-vscode-theme-name');\n",
       "\n",
       "    if (themeKindAttr && themeNameAttr) {\n",
       "        const themeKind = themeKindAttr.toLowerCase();\n",
       "        const themeName = themeNameAttr.toLowerCase();\n",
       "\n",
       "        if (themeKind.includes(\"dark\") || themeName.includes(\"dark\")) {\n",
       "            return \"dark\";\n",
       "        }\n",
       "        if (themeKind.includes(\"light\") || themeName.includes(\"light\")) {\n",
       "            return \"light\";\n",
       "        }\n",
       "    }\n",
       "\n",
       "    // Check Jupyter theme\n",
       "    if (body.getAttribute('data-jp-theme-light') === 'false') {\n",
       "        return 'dark';\n",
       "    } else if (body.getAttribute('data-jp-theme-light') === 'true') {\n",
       "        return 'light';\n",
       "    }\n",
       "\n",
       "    // Guess based on a parent element's color\n",
       "    const color = window.getComputedStyle(element.parentNode, null).getPropertyValue('color');\n",
       "    const match = color.match(/^rgb\\s*\\(\\s*(\\d+)\\s*,\\s*(\\d+)\\s*,\\s*(\\d+)\\s*\\)\\s*$/i);\n",
       "    if (match) {\n",
       "        const [r, g, b] = [\n",
       "            parseFloat(match[1]),\n",
       "            parseFloat(match[2]),\n",
       "            parseFloat(match[3])\n",
       "        ];\n",
       "\n",
       "        // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HSL_and_HSV#Lightness\n",
       "        const luma = 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b;\n",
       "\n",
       "        if (luma > 180) {\n",
       "            // If the text is very bright we have a dark theme\n",
       "            return 'dark';\n",
       "        }\n",
       "        if (luma < 75) {\n",
       "            // If the text is very dark we have a light theme\n",
       "            return 'light';\n",
       "        }\n",
       "        // Otherwise fall back to the next heuristic.\n",
       "    }\n",
       "\n",
       "    // Fallback to system preference\n",
       "    return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "\n",
       "function forceTheme(elementId) {\n",
       "    const estimatorElement = document.querySelector(`#${elementId}`);\n",
       "    if (estimatorElement === null) {\n",
       "        console.error(`Element with id ${elementId} not found.`);\n",
       "    } else {\n",
       "        const theme = detectTheme(estimatorElement);\n",
       "        estimatorElement.classList.add(theme);\n",
       "    }\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "forceTheme('sk-container-id-9');</script></body>"
      ],

   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "from sklearn.decomposition import PCA\n",
    "from sklearn.cluster import KMeans\n",
    "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",
    "\n",
    "# Features\n",
    "features = df[['salary_usd', 'experience_years', 'employee_satisfaction']]\n",
    "\n",
    "# Scale\n",
    "scaler = StandardScaler()\n",
    "scaled = scaler.fit_transform(features)\n",
    "\n",
    "# PCA to 2D\n",
    "pca = PCA(n_components=2)\n",
    "X_pca = pca.fit_transform(scaled)\n",
    "\n",
    "# KMeans\n",
    "kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=4, random_state=42)\n",
    "labels = kmeans.fit_predict(X_pca)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create meshgrid\n",
    "x_min, x_max = X_pca[:,0].min() - 1, X_pca[:,0].max() + 1\n",
    "y_min, y_max = X_pca[:,1].min() - 1, X_pca[:,1].max() + 1\n",
    "\n",
    "xx, yy = np.meshgrid(\n",
    "    np.linspace(x_min, x_max, 200),\n",
    "    np.linspace(y_min, y_max, 200)\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Predict for each point in grid\n",
    "Z = kmeans.predict(np.c_[xx.ravel(), yy.ravel()])\n",
    "Z = Z.reshape(xx.shape)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Plot regions\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))\n",
    "plt.contourf(xx, yy, Z, alpha=0.3)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Plot actual points\n",
    "plt.scatter(X_pca[:,0], X_pca[:,1], c=labels)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.title(\"KMeans Cluster Regions (PCA Projection)\")\n",
    "plt.xlabel(\"PCA 1\")\n",
    "plt.ylabel(\"PCA 2\")\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]

    "from sklearn.cluster import KMeans\n",
    "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",
    "\n",
    "# 1. Select features\n",
    "features = df[['salary_usd', 'experience_years']]\n",
    "\n",
    "# 2. Scale features (VERY IMPORTANT)\n",
    "scaler = StandardScaler()\n",
    "scaled_features = scaler.fit_transform(features)\n",
    "\n",
    "# 3. Fit KMeans\n",
    "kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=2, random_state=42)\n",
    "df['cluster_se'] = kmeans.fit_predict(scaled_features)\n",
    "\n",
    "# 4. View cluster centers (converted back to original scale)\n",
    "centers = scaler.inverse_transform(kmeans.cluster_centers_)\n",
    "print(\"Cluster Centers (Salary, Experience):\")\n",
    "print(centers)"

    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",
    "from sklearn.cluster import KMeans\n",

    "# Filter USA\n",
    "df_usa = df[df['country'] == 'USA'].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Encode education\n",
    "education_map = {\n",
    "    'High School': 1,\n",
    "    'Bachelor': 2,\n",
    "    'Master': 3,\n",
    "    'PhD': 4\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "df_usa['education_encoded'] = df_usa['education_required'].map(education_map)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Drop rows where encoding failed\n",
    "df_usa = df_usa.dropna(subset=['salary_usd', 'experience_years', 'education_encoded'])\n",
    "\n",
    "# Features\n",
    "features = df_usa[['salary_usd', 'experience_years', 'education_encoded']]\n",
    "\n",
    "# Scale\n",
    "scaler = StandardScaler()\n",
    "scaled_features = scaler.fit_transform(features)\n",
    "\n",
    "# KMeans\n",
    "kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=4, random_state=42)\n",
    "df_usa['cluster_usa'] = kmeans.fit_predict(scaled_features)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Sanity check\n",
